en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara and Muhammad Bin Muslim, and Bureyd Bin MUawiya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding the woman whose husband is absent from her, when he dies. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman widowed from her husband should observe the waiting period from the day the news comes to her, because she mourns over him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah from Zurarah Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Burayd who has said the following: “About the case of a woman whose husband is absent when he dies, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
She must count her waiting period from the day the news reaches her because she commences mourning for him.’”
